text.en:
That portion of Barangay Culiat in Quezon City, Metro Manila, which is bounded on the
Northeast by Tandang Sora, on the East by Tandang Sora Avenue, on the Southeast by Don Mariano Marcos
Avenue, on the South by Central Avenue, on the Southwest by Sitio Mabilog and Milton Hills Subdivision
and on the West by Lots Nos. 689, 680, 678 and 687 of the Piedad Estate and by San Antonio Subdivision,
except the property belonging to or occupied by the Claretian Order, the Philippines Assembly of the First
Born and the Muslim Conference of the Philippines, is hereby detached and separated from said Barangay and
is formed and constituted into a distinct and independent barangay to be known as Barangay New Era without
affecting in any other manner the legal existence of the mother barangay of Culiat.

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law, now or hereafter applicable to regular
barangays, shall be applicable to Barangay New Era.

The present elective barangay officials of Barangay Culiat shall continue to perform their duties
as such in the newly-created Barangay New Era until its barangay officials shall have been appointed by the
President. The officials so appointed shall hold office until their successors shall have been elected in the
regular elections for barangay officials following the issuance of this Decree and shall have qualified unless
sooner removed at the pleasure of the President. Such appointive officers and employees as may be necessary
to organize Barangay New Era or complete its complement of government and personnel shall be appointed as
provided for under existing laws.

Upon the effectivity of this Decree, the proportionate share of Barangay New Era in the
obligations, funds, assets and other property of Barangay Culiat shall be transferred by the President to the
newly created Barangay upon recommendation by the Commission on Audit.

All laws or parts thereof, as well as executive orders or regulations inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
